name: 暗之指名者
desc: 宣言1个怪兽卡名。有宣言的卡在对方卡组的场合，那1张卡加入对方手卡。
faq:
If you activate "Dark Designator" and your opponent says he/she has no cards in their Deck of that name, you may check the Deck to verify.
You cannot declare a nonexistent card for "Dark Designator".
Your opponent must show you the card added to his hand.
ruling: If the player required to search for the Monster Card designated by “Dark Designator’s” effect does not have the specified card in his/her Deck, the controller of “Dark Designator” may search the opponent’s Deck to verify this.
